description: Letter filter test vectors shared by wl_core::filter (Rust) and web/src/model/filter.ts. Grammar: docs/architecture.md, "Letter filter". Each case parses `text` (rules separated by |) for words of `word_length` letters; `canonical` is the formatted text (format(parse(text))); `rules` is the parsed structure in JSON (lowercase letters, sets sorted and deduplicated, one-letter sets as letters); `matches` maps each word to whether it matches the rules combined with `combine` ("all" or "any"), with Y counted as a vowel when `y_vowel` is true. Words of another length never match. `errors` are texts that must not parse; `at` is the 0-based character index of the problem. `scope_cases` check matchesNode: a node matches when its guess number `turn` is in `rows` (empty = every row), it is not a final solving guess unless `include_final`, and its word matches the rules.
